subject: Common sampler struct review: compare-enable and integer border use are missing
body: Texture proposal exact API names accepted for review, subject to root file ownership. Two needed fields before freeze: sampler compare_function alone cannot express whether this use compares. Pinned panvk_vX_sampler.c uses compareEnable ? compareOp : ALWAYS; Metal default Never on a regular sample must not become hardware compare Never. Add plan-derived compare_enabled. Also sampler border representation needs integer/float class (and exact raw uint32 RGBA words for integer border) because one Metal sampler may be consumed by float and integer textures; plan WriteSource::Sampler/SamplerSource::Slot carry compare, integer, opaque_black per use. Produce per-use packed sampler, not one immutable packed descriptor per Metal object. n2t_sampler_state may keep common userstate plus pack options(compare_enabled, integer_border, opaque_black remap), whichever consumers ACK. Use exact Rust sampler_desc result where possible. Table indexes remain native descriptor binding, distinct from Metal slot.
